review: Doamne ajută. I was twenty and standing in the square in Timișoara in December 1989 and I have never told that story as though I were anybody in it. Two of the girls I stood beside did not make it out of the nineties. "Plânsul de-o Noapte." Weeping for a night. Then "Bucuria Vine Dimineața" and I had to sit down on the floor of my sewing room. Thirty-six years and somebody finally put that morning into Romanian and into a song. I have played it for eleven people on this street. Five stars, and God bless whoever wrote it.
